heading: Task force on job repatriation and manufacturing growth
lead: The Secretary of Commerce shall maintain a task force on job repatriation and manufacturing growth and shall produce an annual report on related incentive strategies, implementation plans and program results.

notes.text: Codification Section is from the appropriation act cited as the credit to this section.

Similar ProvisionsSimilar provisions were contained in the following prior appropriation acts: Pub. L. 113–76, div. B, title I, Jan. 17, 2014, 128 Stat. 50. Pub. L. 113–6, div. B, title I, Mar. 26, 2013, 127 Stat. 240.
